$description: Canonical 12-page list for the Ledo Odoo Design System Penpot file. Mirrors docs/penpot/PHASED_BUILDOUT.md → Phase 1. Single source of truth for both the build script (scripts/penpot-build-phase-1-skeleton.mjs) and the contract test (tests/pages.test.mjs).

pages.name: 01 — Foundations
pages.purpose: Vector specimens for every token group (Phase 2).

pages.name: 03 — Shared Components
pages.purpose: OdsChip, OdsInitialsAvatar, OdsCardTile, OdsIcon as Penpot library components (Phase 3).

pages.name: 04 — 18.0 Deltas
pages.purpose: Differences when the design system runs on Odoo 18.0.

pages.name: 05 — 19.0 Deltas
pages.purpose: Release notes / changes specific to Odoo 19.0.

pages.name: 06 — Patterns
pages.purpose: Composed primitives — spined card, chip row, form hero (Phase 4+).

pages.name: 08 — Portal Templates
pages.purpose: Portal grid, empty state, mobile-portrait, breadcrumb (Phase 8).

pages.name: 09 — Reports
pages.purpose: Printable A4 templates — invoice, quotation, delivery slip (Phase 9).

pages.name: 10 — Drafts
pages.purpose: Scratch space for in-flight design proposals.

pages.name: 11 — Changelog
pages.purpose: Page-level audit log of design-system releases.
